# publish

In [EhOsContract.Contract](contract-dsl.md), section `contract`.

```elixir
publish name
```

An integration event: the one way an event leaves the application.

**Arguments**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-publish-name"></a>`name` | `atom` | yes |  | The publication's name. |

**Options**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-publish-as"></a>`as` | `String.t` | yes |  | The versioned name, under the domain's `name:`, like `"my-shop.entry.recorded.v1"`; only that first segment may hold a dash. |
| <a id="contract-publish-from"></a>`from` | `atom` | yes |  | The local event it is built from. |
| <a id="contract-publish-fields"></a>`fields` | `atom \| list(atom)` | yes |  | The fields of that event it carries. |
| <a id="contract-publish-idempotent_on"></a>`idempotent_on` | `atom \| list(atom)` |  | `[]` | The fields that make two deliveries the same fact. |
